tei:div.tei:p: "$ (275)༄༅/ zab mo lta brgyud lugs kyi sems bskyed pa'i cho ga byang chub chen po'i gzhung lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

(276)༄༅/ na mo gu ru buddha bo dhi sa twā ya/ rgyal ba'i grong khyer mchog tu bgrod pa yi// gzhung lam 'jug pa bde zhing don che ba// byang chub sems dang de nyid sgo du mas// ston mdzad sras dang bcas la gus phyag 'tshal// bstan pa 'di la gzhan dring mi 'jog par// rgyal ba'i sras kyi lta spyod nyin mor byed// skye rgu'i yid mkhar 'dren mdzad 'phags bod du// ji snyed byon pa rnams la'ang dad pas 'dud// shing rta che gnyis grags pa'i ring lugs las// zab mo lta ba brgyud pa'i bka' srol gyi// sems bskyed cho ga'i phyag len ma 'khrul ba// rgyal sras gong ma'i gsung bzhin dgod par bya/ gang zhig byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa tshul bzhin brgyud pa ldan pa'i slob dpon gyis/ dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed pa'i cho ga rgyal sras zhi ba lha'i lugs bzhin bgyid pa la don gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi cho ga'o// dang po ni/ gtsang zhing yig (277)du 'ong ba'i gnas khang rgyan gyi bkod pa du mas legs par brgyan pa'i gung du/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel gyi snying po can gyi thub pa'i dbang po'i sku brnyan la sogs pa'i rten gsum khyad par can ci 'byor bshams pa'i mdun tu chu gnyis dang*/ nyer spyod brgya phreng gis mtshon/ mchod pa'i yo byad ci 'byor rgya chen po// maṇḍal me tog bcas/ dkon mchog /chos skyong*/ dpal mgon/ gzhi bdag bcas dkar gsum gyi gtsang gtor cha bzhi rnams legs par bsham mo// de nas slob dpon rang nyid khrus bya/ phung po gsum pa'i mdo lan gsum 'don bzhin phyag bya/ ji snyed su dag sogs yan lag bdun pa sngon du btang*/ thal mo sbyar te pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ ngag tu/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ rang gi ming nas smros te/ bdag (278)ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/

dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi// zhes sogs nas/ tshogs la'ang de bzhin skyabs su mchi/ ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs nas bslab par bgyi// zhes pa'i bar lan gsum dang*/ deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu zhes sogs dang*/ byang chub sems ni rin po che/ zhes sogs kyi bsngo ba smon lam gyis bar gyis byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa blangs nas rang rgyud kyi sdom par rnam par dag par byas/ de nas chos kyi khri chen po'i steng du gdan mthon po la 'khod do/ de nas slob ma rnams khrus byas gral la 'khod pa la/ slob dpon gyis chos thams cad stong pa nyid du rtogs pa'i shes rab dang*/ sems can thams cad phan bde la dgod par 'dod pa'i brtse ba dang*/ khyad par du slob ma rnams la byang chub kyi sems bskyed par 'dod pa'i bsam pa bzang po dang ldan pas 'di skad brjod par bya ste/ 'o skol rnams kyis tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa'i khur shes rgyud kyi steng na bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod pa de dag ma bshags na/ dge ba byas pa stobs chung zhing 'phags pa dgyes pa'i lam du mi 'gyur bas bshags dgos/ de'ang stobs bzhi'i sgo nas bshags na sdig pa ji ltar che yang 'dag par gsungs pas/ de ltar bsgrub pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkha' seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du/ bstan pa'i bdag po seng ge sku mdog gser gtso ma lta bu phyag gnyis sa gnon dang mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgyas bzhugs pa/ de'i mthar skor du ltung ba bshags pa'i yul sangs rgyas sum cu rtsa lnga gtso bor gyur pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bsam gyis mi khyab pa nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs par mos pa bya ba ni rten gyi stobs/ de dag gi drung du bdag gzhan (279)sems can thams cad lus dang mgo bo dang lce dpag tu med pa sprul te/

sngar byas kyi sdig pa la 'gyod sems drag po byed pa rnam par sun 'byin pa'i stobs/ phyin chad srog la bab kyang mi byed snyam pa gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs/ de ltar byas pa ltung ba thams cad dag nges snyam pa sor chud pa'i stobs te/ de dag dran bzhin pa'i sgo nas ltung ba bshags pa tshar gsum phyag 'tshal ba dang bcas te gdon par zhu/ zhes byas la phyag 'tshal bzhin pas ltung bshags tshar gsum 'don du gzhug /de nas thams cad gral du 'khod pa la slob dpon gyis 'di ltar brjod do/ /'o skol rnams rnyed par dka' ba dal 'byor gyi rten khyad par can rnyed mjal bar dka' ba sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dang mjal/ 'khor 'das kyi 'dam kha rang dbang thob pa'i dus 'dir dal 'byor la snying po lon pa zhig ci nas kyang 'bad dgos te/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ rgya mtsho gcig gnas gnya' shing bu ga dang*// rus lbal 'phrad pa bas kyang dud 'gro las// mi nyid ches thob dka' bas mi dbang gis// dam chos spyad pas de 'bras mchis bar mdzod/ ces gsungs shing*/ dam pa'i chos kyi nang nas kyang rang gzhan thams cad sdug bsngal las sgrol zhing*/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde ba dam pa thob par byed pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo byang chub kyi sems yin te bslab btus las// sdug bsngal mthar phyin 'dod pa dang*// bde ba'i mthar yang 'gro 'dod pas// dad pa'i rtsa ba brtan byas te// byang chub la ni blo brtan bya/ zhes gsungs pas mtshon yon tan dpag tu med pa dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed kyi cho ga sgrub pa la/ thog mar sdom pa'i rang bzhin gtan la bab pa'i tshul mdo tsam smos na/ sems bskyed kyi ngo bo// dbye ba/ so so'i sa mtshams/ sems (280)bskyed kyi rgyu/ phan yon nyes dmigs/ cho ga'i khyad par rnams las/ dang po ni/ gzhan don du sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa ste/ mngon rtogs rgyan las// sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir// yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod// ces dang*/

mdo sde rgyan las// don gnyis ldan pa'i sems 'byung ba/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin no// gnyis pa bye ba ni/ gzhan don du byang chub thob par 'dod pa smon pa dang*/ gzhan don du byang chub tu 'gro bzhin pa ni 'jug pa ste bsam pas 'gro 'dod dang sbyor bas 'gro bzhin pa lta bur spyod 'jug las// byang chub sems de mdor bsdu na// rnam pa gnyis su shes bya ste// byang chub smon pa'i sems dang ni// byang chub 'jug pa nyid yin no// 'gro bar 'dod dang 'gro ba yi// bye brag ji ltar shes par ltar// de bzhin mkhas pas 'di gnyis kyi// bye brag rim bzhin shes par bya/ zhes pa dang*/ kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i sgo nas kyang rnam pa gnyis te/ myang 'das las// kun rdzob don dam dbye ba yis// byang chub sems de rnam pa gnyis/ zhes pas/ phyi rol sems can la dmigs te so skye la gtso bor skye ba kun rdzob sems bskyed dang*/ nang sems nyid la dmigs te gtso bor 'phags rgyud la skye ba don dam sems bskyed yin no// des na smon pa byang chub kyi sems ni byang chub tu smon pa tsam las kyang skye zhing*/ 'jug pa'i sems bskyed ni cho ga las skyes pa'i sdom pa yin te/ de gnyis ka'ang kun rdzob sems bskyed du 'du la/ don dam sems bskyed ni de'i chos nyid goms pa'i stobs las so// gsum pa sa mtshams ni/ smon sems ni// dang po sems bskyed ma thag nas sdom pa ma bzung bar gyi tshogs lam chung ngu nas yod la/ 'jug sems ni/(281)'jug sdom bzung nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod te// 'gro bar 'dod dang 'gro ba yi/ zhes sogs kyis 'grub cing*/ gal te 'jug sems 'phags lam kho na na yod dam zhe na ma nges te/ sdom pa'i rten so skye'i rten can du grub pa dang*/ gzhan du 'jug sdom blangs nas rtsa ltung spyod pa mi srid par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// bzhi pa sems bskyed kyi rgyu ni/

sangs rgyas la dmigs pa'i dad pas sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje// byang chub sems kyi phan yon shes nas thob par 'dod pa ste gsum las skye bar mdo sde rgyan las// grogs stobs rgyu stobs rtsa ba'i stobs// thos stobs dge ba goms pa las// mi brtan pa dang brtan 'byung ba// gzhan gyis brtan pa'i sems bskyed bshad/ ces pas grogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen la brten cing thos pa byas pa las smon pa sems bskyed mi brtan pa'i rgyu dang por 'byung zhing*/ rang gis dge ba goms pa dang rgyu rigs sad pa dang*// rtsa ba snying rje skyes pa las/ 'jug pa sems bskyed brtan par skye ba'i rgyur gsungs so// lnga pa sems bskyed pa'i phan yon ni/ smon pa sems bskyed kyis nyan rang gis sems bskyed pa la sogs pa'i bsod nams thams cad zil gyis non cing*/ 'jug sems kyis rtsa ltung ma byung na gnyid 'thug po log pa'am/ bag med par gyur kyang bsod nams rgyun mi chad pa 'byung ba ste/ spyod 'jug la// deng nas bzung ste gnyid log gam// bag med gyur kyang bsod nams shugs// rgyun mi chad pa du ma zhig /nam mkha' mnyam par rab tu 'byung*// zhes sogs mtha' yas par gsungs pa las cha shas tsam sngar brjod zin no// drug pa sems ma bskyed pa'i nyes dmigs ni/ gtso bor 'khor ba dang ngan song du ltung ba rgyun (282)mi chad cing*/ ji ltar chos la 'bad kyang nyan rang du gol ba dang*/ dmyal bar ltung ba byang chub kyi gtan gegs ma yin kyang*/ nyan rang dgra bcom du ltung ba ni grangs med pa'i bskal par bla na med pa rdzogs byang gi gegs yin pa'i phyir ro// bdun pa cho ga'i khyad par ni/ sdong po bkod pa dang*/ nam mkha'i snying po'i mdo la sogs pa'i rjes su 'brangs pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal nas brgyud de mgon po klu sgrub yab sras dang rgyal sras zhi ba lha sogs kyi phyag bzhes dbu ma lugs su grags pa dang*/

byang chub sems dpa'i sa chen po'i mdo la sogs pa'i rjes su 'brangs pa/ mgon po byams pa nas brgyud de 'phags pa thogs med sku mched dang*/ slob dpon chen po tsand+ra go mi dang jo bo a ti sha sogs kyi phyag bzhes sems tsam lugs su grags pa gnyis yod/ de dag kyang blang bya'i yul/ len pa po'i gang zag /len byed cho ga// mi nyams par srung tshul gyi khyad par sogs theg pa chen po'i mdo dang bstan bcos rnams las rtogs par bya dgos shing*/ 'dir dbu ma lugs kyi cho ga bsgrub par bgyi ba yin/ de la thog mar sdom pa len pa'i tshul/ bar du mi nyams par bsrung ba'i tshul mthar nyams na phyir bcos pa'i tshul dang gsum las/ dang po la gang las blangs pa'i yul/ gang gis len pa'i gang zag /ji ltar len pa'i cho ga dngos bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ theg pa chen po la mos shing byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa la gnas pa/ byang sems kyi sde snod spyi dang khyad par byang sdom 'bogs pa dang bslab bya la dkri mkhas shing*/ phar phyin drug gi mi mthun phyogs ser sna sogs dang bral ba ste/ spyod 'jug las// rtag par dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni// theg chen don la mkhas pa dang*// (283)byang chub sems dpa'i brtul zhugs mchog /srog gi phyir yang mi gtong ngo*// zhes gsungs so// lugs 'di la sems bskyed gsar du len pa dang nyams pa gso ba gnyis ka slob dpon ma 'byor na rten gyi drung du blangs pas kyang rung bar bshad do// gnyis pa ni/ gzugs med khams pa dang 'du shes med pa'i lha ma gtogs sems can brda shes shing sdom pa len 'dod yod pa kun la skye bar bshad pa dang*/ khyad par shes rab kyis byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa brlabs po che rnams la legs par rtogs shing*/ de dag shin tu sgrub dka' bar shes kyang*/ snying rje chen pos sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las sgrol bar 'dod cing*/ de la rang gi sangs rgyas thob dgos par shes nas/

sangs rgyas thob pa'i don du byang chub tu sems bskyed cing*/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la slob par 'dod pa zhig yin te/ bslab btus las/ sems can chen po gang*/ de lta bu thos nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dka' ba shes rab kyis rtogs par byas nas/ skye bo ma lus pa sdug bsngal las bskyab par khur khyer ba des ni/ phyag bya ba dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ sdig pa bshags pa dang*/ bsod nams la rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ sangs rgyas la bskul ba dang*/ gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ byang chub tu bsngo ba byas la/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la gsol ba gdab ste/ de'i tshig gis rjes su brjod pa'am/ yang na rang nyid kyis brjod pa zhes gsungs so// gsum pa ji ltar len pa'i tshul gyis cho ga la// sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi mjug gi cho ga dang gsum yod/ dang po sbyor ba la'ang bzhi/ man ngag khyad par can gyi blo bcos pa/ yul khyad par can la gsol ba gdab pa// rten khyad (284)par la skyabs su 'gro ba/ thabs khyad par gyi sgo nas tshogs bsags cing sgrib pa sbyong ba'o// dang po la'ang*/ sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i mtha' la skyo ba bskyed pa/ zhi ba myang 'das kyi mtha' la zhan pa dgag pa/ mtha' gnyis dang bral ba'i lam byang chub kyi sems la spro ba bskyed pa gsum gyi dang po ni/ 'khor ba 'di sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yin te/ dmyal ba la rigs bco brgyad yod pa las/ tsha dmyal ni/ yang sos/ thig nag /bsdus 'joms/ ngu 'bod/ ngu 'bod chen po// tsha ba/ rab tu tsha ba/ mnar med pa ste brgyad yin/ de rnams la phan tshun mtshon gyis 'debs pa dang*/ sog les 'gra ba dang*/ ri gnyis 'dus nas bcom pa dang*/ lcags mdung me 'bar ba bsnan nas lcags sreg gi sa gzhi la brdabs pa dang*/ lcags kyi khang pa me 'bar ba sgo med pa'i nang du chud pa dang*/ thabs chen po'i nang du bzod thabs med pa'i chu tshan gyis btsos pa dang*/ phyogs bcu thams cad mes gang bas bsreg pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa yod cing*/

de thams cad mi dge ba chen po'i 'bras bu yin te// byang chub sems dpa'i spyod 'jug las/ gshin rje'i skyes bus pags pa ma lus bshus pas shin tu nyam thag cing*/ rab tu tsha ba'i me yis bzhus pa'i zangs zhun lus la blugs gyur la/ 'bar ba'i ral gri mdung thung gis bsnun sha yi dum bu brgyar lhags shing*/ shin tu 'bar ba'i lcags kyi sa gzhir ltung bar mi dge mang pos 'gyur/ zhes gsungs/ grangs dmyal ni/ chu bur can/ chu bur rdol ba/ a chu zer ba/ kye hud zer ba/ so tam tam pa/ utpal ltar gas pa/ padma ltar gas pa/ padma ltar cher (285)gas pa ste brgyad yin la/ de dag shin tu grang bas lus la chu bur gyi tshogs byung zhing smre sngags 'don pa dang*/ sha rus gas pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal mang po yod de/ slob spring las/ lhags pa dpe med rus pa la yang thim pa yis/ lus sbrebs 'dar sha bskur nas kum kum bor 'dug pa// chu bur brgya byung rdol pa las skyes srog chags kyis/ ral gri dbang nas zhag dang chu ser rkang bcas 'dzag /ces gsungs/ nye 'khor ba ni/ me ma mur gyi 'ob chen por lhung ba dang*/ ro myags kyi 'dam du lhung nas srog chags kyis sha rus 'bigs pa dang*/ spu gri brdal ba'i thang la lus gang reg spu gris gcod pa dang*/ ral gri lo ma'i nags rlung gis bskyod pas/ ral gri chad nas lus du ma bur gtong ba dang*/ shal mal ri'i sdong po lcags kyi tsher ma sor bcu drug yod pa la 'bab 'dzegs byas pas lus rgyus pa bshad pa bzhin 'gro ba dang*/ chu bo rab med ces bya ba chu shin tu tsha bar lhung nas lus rus par zangs kyi sa gtong ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal mang po yod cing*/ de dag tsha ba'i dmyal ba'i phyogs bzhin thams cad tshang ba re re yod de/ mdzod las// de dag gi ni ngos bzhin// me ma mur dang ro myags 'dam// spu gri lam sogs chu bo yin/ zhes gsungs/ nyi tshe ba ni/

rgya mtsho'i 'gram la sogs pa sna tshogs na yod cing*/ lus la me 'bar ba dang*/ srog chags kyis zab la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal yod pas/ de ltar dmyal ba pa rnams la sdug bsngal shin tu mang po yod de// bshes spring las// 'di na nyin gcig mdung thung sum brgya yis// rab tu drag btab sdug bsngal gang lags pa// des ni dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal chung ngu la'ang*// 'o ma (286)yang mi mchi char yang mi phod do// zhes gsungs/ yi dwags rnams la lo zla mang por zas skom cung zad kyang mi rnyed pas/ bkres skom gyis gzir ba dang*/ tsha grang la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal yod de/ bshes spring las/ yi dwags na yang 'dod pas phongs pa yis// bskyed pa'i sdug bsngal rgyun chags mi 'chos pa// bkres skom grang dro ngal dang 'jigs pa yis// bskyed pa shin tu mi bzad bsten 'tshal lo// zhes gsungs/ dud 'gro rnams la'ang gcig la gcig za ba dang*/ bkol ba dang*/ sha dang pags pa la sogs pa'i ched du gsod pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal mang po yod de/ bshes spring las// dud 'gro'i skye gnas na yang bsad pa dang*// bcing dang brdeg sogs sdug bsngal sna tshogs pa// zhi 'gyur dge ba spangs pa rnams la ni// gcig la gcig za shin tu mi bzad pa// kha cig mu tig bal dang rus pa dang*// sha dang pags pa'i ched du 'chi bar 'gyur// dbang med gzhan gyi rdog pa lag pa dang*// lcags dang lcags kyus btab pas btab ste bkol/ ces gsungs// mi rnams la'ang skye rga na 'chi dang*// med pa btsal du ma rnyed pa dang*// yod pa bsrung gis ma thub pa dang*// dgra sdang ba dang 'phrad pa dang*/ gnyen byams pa dang bral ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal mang po 'dug pa de rang res mthong ba 'di yin/ lha ma yin rnams la lha'i dpal 'byor la phrag dog byed pas lus bshag pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal mang po yod do/ lha min gnas na'ang rang bzhin gyis lha yi// dpal la sdang phyir yid kyi sdug bsngal che// de dag blo dang ldan na'ang 'gro ba yi// sgrib pas bden pa mthong ba ma mchis so// zhes gsungs/

(287)'dod khams kyi lha rnams la'ang 'chi ltas byung ba'i dus su lha'i dpal 'byor la chags shing*/ de nas 'chi bar shes nas sdug bsngal chen po 'byung ste// mtho ris na yang bde chen de dag gi// 'chi 'pho'i sdug bsngal nyid ni de bas che/ zhes gsungs so// gzugs dang gzugs med kyi khams kyi lha rnams la re zhig sdug bsngal kyi sdug bsngal med kyang*/ de nas shi 'phos nas ngan song rnams su'ang skye bar 'gyur ba yod de// lha yul 'dod pa de shin tu chen po dang*/ tshangs nyid chags bral bde ba thob nas slar// mnar med me yi bud shing gyur pa yi// sdug bsngal rgyun mi 'chad pa bstan 'tshal lo// zhes gsungs/ des na 'khor ba thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yin/ mdo dran pa nyer bzhag las// sems can dmyal ba dmyal mes nyams// yi dwags bkres shing skom pas nyams// dud 'gro gcig la gcig zas nyams// mi rnams 'tsho ba thung bas nyams// lha rnams bag med pa yi nyams// 'khor ba khab kyi rtse rtsam yang*// bde ba nam yang yod ma yin/ zhes gsungs shing*/ mgon po byams pas kyang mi gtsang ba la dri zhim med bzhin 'gro lnga dag na bde ba med/ ces gsungs/ des na 'khor ba mtha' dag las skyo ba skyed cing de las thar bar bya ba'i phyir 'bad par bya ba de las dgos pa che ba gzhan ni 'ga' yang med/ bshes spring las/ mgo bo'am gos la blo bur me shor na/ de dag bzlog phyir bgyi ba btang nas kyang*/ yang srid med par bgyi slad 'bad 'tshal te/ 'di bas ches mchog dgos pa gzhan ma mchis/ zhes gsungs pas/ 'khor ba las thar bar bya ba'i phyir dam pa'i chos la 'bad (288)par bya'o snyam pa'i bsam pa zhe thag pa nas bskyed 'tshal lo// gnyis pa zhi ba myang 'das kyi mtha' la zhen pa dgag pa ni/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yin pas/ de spang nas nyan rang gi lugs kyi phung po lhag med kyi myang 'das thob na/

sdug bsngal gtan nas med par 'gyur bas de thob par bya ba yin snyam na ma yin te/ des gzhan don mi 'grub la/ 'khor ba'i sems can thams cad thog ma med pa nas mar byas pa'i drin can yin pas/ de rnams kyi don mi byed par rang nyid lhag med kyi myang 'das sgrub pa ni/ drin mi shes pas khrel med pa'i spyod bar 'gyur te/ slob spring las// nye du 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i khongs su chud gyur pa// klong gi nang na ltung ba lta bur snang bzhin du/ skye shi 'phos pas ngo ma shes pa de bor nas// gal te gcig thar byed na de las khrel bor med// byis pa sang na bca' ba ci yang mi nus pa// gang gi nu zho byams pa'i shugs kyis zag 'thungs pa// ngal ba mang brten byams pa brten pa de dag 'dir// shin tu ma rabs zhig na'ang spong bar su zhig spro/ zhes gsungs pas/ gzhan don dor nas rang nyid gcig pu zhi bde thob par 'dod pa'i blo spang 'tshal lo// gsum pa mtha' gnyis dang bral ba'i lam byang chub kyi sems la spro ba skyed pa ni/ 'khor ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yin pas spangs dgos shing*/ sdug bsngal thams cad spangs pa'i myang 'das de'ang thob par mi byed na// ci zhig thob par bya yin snyam na/ myang 'das phyogs gcig pa de thob bya ba ma yin yang*/ mgon po byams pas/ bdag sred ma lus shes rab kyis bsal nas// sems can sred phyir brtse ldan zhi thob min// de ltar blo rtse byang chub thabs brten nas// 'phags pa 'khor ba'am mya ngan 'da' mi 'gyur/ (289)zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shes rab chen pos 'khor ba'i mtha' la mi gnas/ snying rje chen pos mya ngan las 'das pa'i mtha' la mi gnas pas na mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa zhes bya ste/ de nyid yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yin la/ de thob na rang don du spangs rtogs thams cad mthar phyin/ gzhan don du 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mthas gtugs par phrin las grangs med pa 'bad med lhun grub tu mdzad pas na/

rang gzhan gyi don mthar thug pa yin pas/ de thob par bya ba'i phyir yin no// de thob byed kyi rgyu de ni gtso bo byang chub tu sems bskyed pa yin te rnam snang mngon byang gi rgyud las/ gsang ba'i bdag po thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi rgyu ni byang chub sems so zhes gsungs shing*/ mdo sdud pa las// de bzhin 'dir yang byang chub sems med bde gshegs kyi// ye shes 'jig rten 'di dag kun tu ga la 'byung*/ zhes sems bskyed med na sangs rgyas mi 'byung la// chu yis thigs pas bum pa dang po tha ma'i bar// rim gyis nyung ngu nyung ngus de yang 'gengs pa ltar// de bzhin dang po'i sems kyang byang chub mchog rgyu ste// rim gyis dkar po'i yon tan rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya ba'i phyir/ byang chub tu sems bskyed par bya'o snyam pa'i spro ba chen po bskyed par zhu/ gnyis pa yul yul khyad par can la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ khyed rnams sems bskyed zhu bar 'dod pas/ slob dpon la gsol ba gdab dgos pas/ slob dpon la ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed nas/ byang chub mchog tu sems skyed pa (290)zhu ba'i yon tu maṇḍal 'bul mdzod/

ces dang maṇḍal tshom bu so bdun ma dang*/ deng nas byang chub sogs sam tshigs su bcad pa gang rung gis 'bul du gzhug /de ltar maṇḍal phul nas/ phyag me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar te bdag cag la byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa stsal du gsol snyam pa'i 'dun pa chen po dang ldan pa'i sgo nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rigs kyi bu bdag la dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam skyabs gsum sngon du 'gro ba can gyi byang chub tu sems bskyed pa stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab bo/ /gnyis pa rten khyad par can la skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul/ sangs rgyas sku gsum gyi bdag nyid/ chos theg pa chen po'i lung dang rtogs pa/ dge 'dun byang sems 'phags pa phyir mi ldog pa rnams yin la/ dus byang chub snying po'i bar du// rgyu sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las bsgral bar 'dod pa'i snying rjes kun nas bslangs nas/ ngo bo ni sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las sgrol ba la sangs rgyas thob dgos/ sangs rgyas thob pa dkon mchog gsum la rags las pas/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob pa dkon mchog gsum po mkhyen snyam pa'i dang ba chen po dang ldan pa'i sgo nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ rang rang gi ming nas smos nas/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ dus 'di nas bzung ste// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi// chos dang byang chub sems dpa' yi// tshogs la'ang de bzhin skyabs (291)su mchi/ zhes lan gsum gyis skyabs su song nas/ de'i bslab bya la da phyin chad sangs rgyas la ston pa/ theg chen gyi chos la lam/ byang sems 'phags pa rnams la lam sgrub pa'i grogs su gzung bar bya'o snyam pa'i bsam pa mdzod/

gsum pa thabs khyad par can gyi sgo nas tshogs bsags cing sgrib pa sbyang ba ni/ yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba'i yul/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bstan pa'i bdag po bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen po la/ 'khor nye ba'i sras brgyad la sogs pas bskor bas gtso byas pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa bzhugs par bsams nas/ rang gi lus sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul phra rab dang mnyam pa bsam zhing*// de'i rjes su sems can thams cad kyang khrid de/ thog mar phyag 'tshal bar bsams la gnas lnga sa la 'dud pa'i phyag bya ba dang lhan cig rjes zlos kyi tshig rnams dal zhing dod la skabs phyed par brjod pa shin tu gnad che bas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod// dus gsum gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas kun// chos dang tshogs kyi mchog bcas la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud nas ni bdag phyag 'tshal/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ gnyis pa mchod pa dbul ba la bdun las/ dang po dngos su bshams pa'i mchod pa ni/ 'di ltar dngos su bshams pa'i mchod pa 'di rnams lha rjas las grub pa'i/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog /zhal zas/ rol mo/ gtsang zhing dwangs la thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams khengs pa tsam du bsams nas/ de dag dang gzhan yang 'jig rten gyi khams dpag tu med pa na yod pa'i me tog la sogs pa rnams/ bla ma dang phyogs (292)bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la 'bul lo snyam pa'i dmigs 'dun rtse gcig pas sngags tshig phyag rgya rnams kyang rjes zlos sam lhan cig mdzad par zhu/ 'dir gzhung rnying las byin rlabs ma bshad kyang phyis kyi lag len la kun rig ltar sbyar bar mdzad pas spro na de ltar ram/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs sngags lan gsum brjod kyang 'thus/ 'bul tshig ni/ /rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed mchis pa dang*// bdag gi gus pas bsham pa rnams// rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul// ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ārghaṃ pra tītstsha pū dzā me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog /zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dang*/ puṣpe sogs sngags dang 'don pa bsgyur te dbul/ bsdus pa byed na sngags rkyang ngam/ tshig bcad rkyang pas phul yang chog go/ /gnyis pa bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i mchod pa ni/ 'jig rten gyi khams na bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i/ rin po che'i ri bo// dpag bsam gyi shing*/ 'bru dang me tog /sman dang nag tshal la sogs pa thams cad sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams las 'bul bas/ bdag cag gis tshogs rdzogs pa'i don du khyed rnams kyis bzhes su gsol snyam pa'i sgo nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod// rin chen sems de bzung bar bya ba'i phyir// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang dam pa'i chos// dkon mchog dri ma med dang sangs rgyas sras// yon tan rgya mtsho rnams la legs par mchod// me tog 'bras bu ji snyed yod pa dang*// sman gyi rnam par gang dag yod pa dang*// 'jig rten rin chen ji snyed yod pa dang*// chu gtsang yid du 'ong ba (293)ci yod dang*// rin chen ri bo dang ni de bzhin du// nags tshal sa phyogs dben zhing nyams dga' dang*// ljon shing me tog rgyan spras spud pa dang*// shing gang 'bras bzang yal ga dud pa dang*/ lha sogs 'jigs rten na yang dri dang ni// spos dang dpag bsam shing dang rin chen shing*// ma rmos 'khrungs pa'i lo tog rnam pa dang*// mtsho dang rdzing bu padmas brgyan pa dag /ngang pa shin tu skad snyan yid 'ong ldan// gzhan yang mchod par 'os pa'i rgyan rnams ni// nam mkha' rab 'byams khams kyi mtha' gtugs pa// yongs su bzung ba med pa de dag kun// blo yis blangs nas thub pa skyes kyi mchog /sras dang bcas pa rnams la legs 'bul na// yon gnas dam pa thugs rje che rnams kyis// bdag la brtser dgongs bdag gi 'di dag bzhes// bdag ni bsod nams mi ldan bkren chen te// mchod pa'i nor gzhan bdag la cang ma mchis// des na gzhan don dgongs pa'i mgon gyis ni// bdag gi don slad nyid kyi mthus bzhes shig

/ ces brjod do// yang bsdus par byed na/ gzhan yang mchod par 'os pa'i rgyan rnams ni/ zhes pa nas/ bdag gi don slad nyid kyi mthus bzhes shig /ces pa'i bar brjod/ gsum pa lus dbul ba ni/ bdag gi lus 'di sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bran du 'bul nas/ de dag gi bya ba sems can kyi don 'ba' zhig bya'o snyam pa'i sgo nas rjes zlos mdzod// rgyal dang de sras rnams la bdag gis ni// bdag gi lus kun gtan du dbul bar bgyi// sems dpa' mchog rnams bdag ni yongs bzhengs shig /gus pas khyed kyi 'bangs su mchi bar bgyi// bdag ni khyed kyis yongs su bzung bas na// (294)srid la mi 'jigs sems can phan par bgyi// sngon gyi sdig las yang dag 'da' bgyid cing*// sdig pa gzhan yang slan chad mi bgyid do/ /zhes brjod/ bzhi pa blos sprul pa'i mchod pa ni// bdag gi tshig las 'byung ba'i khrus kyi khang pa zhes pa la sogs pa la sogs pa 'di rnams tshigs bcad las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin du/ lam lam byung bar bsgoms nas/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la 'bul bar zhu/ zhes brjod nas/ rang gi tshig dal la dod pa skabs phyed pas 'di rnams brjod par bya'o/ /khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa// shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher ba ltar// rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'od ldan// mu tig 'od chags bla re bres pa der// de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sras rnams la// rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chu// yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni// rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol// de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bsgos pas sku phyi'o// de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i// na bza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa dbul// gos bzang srab la 'jams pa sna tshogs dang*// rgyan mchog brgya phrag de dang de dag gis// 'phags pa kun tu bzang dang 'jam dbyangs dang*/

'jig rten dbang phyug sogs la'ang brgyan par bgyi// stong gsum kun du dri ngad ldan pa yi// dri mchog rnams kyis thub dbang rnams kyi sku// gser byang btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar// 'od chags 'bar ba de dag byug par bgyi// thub dbang mchog gnas mchog la yid 'ong ba'i// me tog man dā ra dang padma dang*// utpal la sogs dri zhim thams cad dang*// phreng ba spel legs yid 'ong rnams kyis mchod// spos mchog yid 'phrog dri ngad khyab pa yi// gdug (295)pa'i sprin tshogs rnams kyang de la dbul// zhal zas bza' btung sna tshogs bcas pa yi// lha bshos rnams kyang de la dbul par bgyi// gser gyi padma tshar du dngar ba yi// rin chen sgron ma rnams kyang dbul bar bgyi// sa gzhi bstar ba spos kyis byugs pa der// me tog yid 'ong sil ma dgram par bgyi// gzhal med pho brang bstod dbyangs yid 'ong ldan// mu tig rin chen rgyan 'phyang mdzes 'bar ba// dpag yas nam mkha'i rgyan gyur de dag kun// thugs rje'i rang bzhin can la dbul bar bgyi// rin chen gdugs mdzes gser gyi yu ba can// khor yug rgyan gyi rnam pa yid 'ong ldan// dbyibs legs lta na sdug pa bsgreng ba yang*// rtag tu thub dbang rnams la dbul bar bgyi/ /zhes brjod par bya'o/ /lnga pa mchod pa yongs su bsngo ba ni// de dag las gzhan yang mchod pa'i bye brag dpag tu med pa sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams mnyes par byed cing*/ sems can rnams kyi sdug bsngal zhi bar byed pa'i mchod pa'i tshogs/ nam mkha'i khams khyab par gnas par gyur cig snyam du bsams nas rjes zlos mdzod// de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs// rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ong ldan// sems can sdug bsngal sel byed pa// sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig /dam chos dkon mchog thams cad dang*// mchod rten rnams dang sku gzugs la// rin chen me tog la sogs char// rgyun mi 'chad pa 'bab par shog

/ces brjod/ drug pa bla na med pa'i mchod pa ni// mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la sogs pa sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis/ mchod rdzas dpag tu med pas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad mchod pa na/ mchod bya mchod byed/ mchod pa rnams bden par (296)mngon par zhen pa med pa ltar/ bdag gis kyang de ltar mngon par zhen pa med pa'i sgo nas/ rgyal ba sras bcas mchod do snyam pa'i bsam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ ji ltar 'jam dbyangs la sogs pas// rgyal ba rnams la mchod mdzad pa// de bzhin bdag gis de bzhin gshegs// mgon po sras dang bcas rnams mchod/ /ces brjod par bya'o/ /bdun pa bstod pas mchod pa ni/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la/ yon tan tshul bzhin brjod pa'i bstod dbyangs rnams kyis bstod do snyam pa'i bsam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ yon tan rgya mtsho rnam la bdag /bstod dbyangs yan lag rgya mtshos bstod// bstod dbyangs snyan sprin de dag la// nges par kun tu 'byung gyur cig /ces brjod nas mdo dbyangs byed du gzhug go / gsum pa sdig pa bshags pa ni/ sngar byas kyi sdig pa la 'gyod pa rnam par sun 'byin pa'i stobs dang*/ phyin chad sdig pa gtan nas mi byed snyam pa nyes pa las bzlog pa'i stobs dang*/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro zhing gzhan don du sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa rten gyi stobs dang*/ sdig pa'i gnyen po rnams nyams su len pa gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs dang*/ stobs bzhi tshangs pas sdig pa thams cad 'dag par chos bzhi bstan pa'i mdo las gsungs pas// sngar byas kyi sdig pa dran yul du byas nas de la 'gyod pa drag po dang*/ da phyin chad srog la bab kyang sdig pa mi byed snyam pa'i zhe bcad chen po dang*/ da ni gzhan don du sangs rgyas thob par bya ba'i phyir/ rten dkon mchog gsum la brten nas sdig pa'i gnyen po'i chos rnams tshul bzhin du nyams su blang bar bya'o snyam pa'i bsam pa zhe thag pa'i sgo nas/

sdig bshags kyi tshig brjod pas/ (297)sdig pa sangs sangs dag par bsgom zhing*/ 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ni mi shes gti mug pas// rang bzhin kha na ma tho dang*// bcas pa'i sdig pa gang yin las// gang yang rung bar bgyis pa rnams// mgon po'i spyan sngar mngon sum du// thal sbyar sdug bsngal 'jigs sems kyis// yang dang yang du phyag 'tshal te// de dag thams cad bshags par bgyi// 'dren pa rnams kyi bdag gi sdig /nongs ba lags par bzung du gsol// 'di ni bzang po ma lags pas// slan chad bdag ni yongs mi bgyid/ ces lan gsum brjod nas/ sdig pa bden med yin pas sangs kyis dag par bsam mo// bzhi pa rjes su yi rang ba'i yan lag ni/ 'phags pa dang so so skye bo'i bde ba dang dge ba thams cad la zhe thag pa nas dga' ba'i bsam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod// sems can kun gyi ngan song gi// sdug bsngal ngal gso'i dge ba dang*// sdug bsngal can dag bder gnas la// dga' bas rjes su yi rang ngo*// byang chub rgyur gyur dge bsags pa// de la rjes su yi rang ngo*// lus can 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las/ nges par thar la yi rang ngo*// skyob pa rnams kyi byang chub dang*// rgyal sras sa la yi rang ngo*// sems can thams cad bde mdzad pa'i// thugs bskyed dge ba rgya mtsho dang*// sems can phan par mdzad pa la// dga' bas rjes su yi rang ngo*/ /zhes brjod/ lnga pa chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba ni/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas nas zhu ba po'i tshogs rdzogs par bya ba la sogs pa'i (298)don du chos kyi 'khor lo mi bskor ba'ang yod pas/ de rnams la gdul bya rnams kyi don du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar zhu snyam pa'i bsam pa zhe thag pas gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod// phyogs rnams kun gyi sangs rgyas la// thal mo sbyar te gsol ba ni// sems can sdug bsngal mun 'thoms la// chos kyi sgron me sbar du gsol/

zhes brjod/ drug pa mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab pa ni// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na// sangs rgyas 'ga' zhig sangs rgyas la dkon pa'i 'du shes bskyed pa la sogs pa'i don du/ mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul ston par bzhed pa yod pa/ de rnams la zhing de rnams kyi gdul bya rnams kyi don du mya ngan las mi 'da' bar yun ring du bzhugs su gsol snyam pa'i bsam pa zhe thag pas/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod// rgyal ba mya ngan 'da' bzhed la// thal mo sbyar te gsol ba ni// 'gro 'di ldongs par mi dgod par// bskal pa grangs med bzhugs par gsol/ zhes brjod/ bdun pa bsngo ba ni/ de ltar phyag 'tshal ba la sogs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal thams cad sel ba dang*/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde ba thams cad 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig snyam pa'i sgo nas rjes zlos mdzod// de ltar 'di dag kun byas te// dge ba bdag gis bsags pa gang*// des ni sems can thams cad kyi// sdug bsngal thams cad sel bar shog /'gro ba nad pa ji srid du// nad sos gyur gyi bar du ni// sman dang sman pa nyid dag dang*// de yi nad g.yog byed par shog /zas dang skom gyi char phab ste// bkres dang skom gyi gnod pa bsal// mu ge'i bskal pa bar ma'i tshe// bdag ni zas dang skom du gyur// sems can phongs shing dbul (299)ba la// bdag ni mi zad gter gyur te// yo byad mkho dgu sna tshogs su// mdun du nye bar gnas gyur cig

/ces brjod/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la blo sbyong ba dang*/ dam bca' ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad thog ma med pa nas yang dang yang du ma byas pa'i drin can yin la/ de dag 'khor ba na sdug bsngal dpag tu med pas gzir 'dug pas/ bdag ni lus dang longs spyod dang dus gsum gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad de dag la btang nas/ de dag gi gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi don gang dang gang dgos pa de 'grub pa'i rgyud gtor zhing*/ dka' spyod dang sdug bsngal thams cad dang du blang bar bya'o snyam pa'i sgo nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ lus dang de bzhin longs spyod dang*// dus gsum dge ba thams cad kyang*// sems can kun gyi don bsgrub phyir// phongs pa med par gtang bar bya// thams cad btang bas mya ngan 'da'// bdag blo mya ngan 'das pa bsgrub// thams cad btang ba chab gcig la// sems can rnams la btang ba mchog /bdag gi lus can thams cad la// lus 'di ci bder byin zin gyis// rtag tu gsod dang gcod pa dang*// brdeg sogs ci dgar byed la rag /bdag gi lus la gtse byed dam// co 'dri ga zha'i rgyu byed kyang*// bdag gi lus 'di byin zin gyis// 'di yi kha tas ci zhig bya// de la gnod par mi 'gyur ba'i// las gang yin pa byed du chug /bdag la dmigs nas nam du yang*// 'ga' yang don med ma gyur cig /bdag la dmigs nas gang dag gis// khro'am dad pa'i sems byung ba// de nyid rtag tu de dag gi// don kun grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig /gang dag bdag la kha zer ram// (300)gzhan dag gnod pa byed pa'am// de bzhin phyar kha gtong yang rung*// thams cad byang chub skal ldan gyur// bdag ni mgon med rnams kyi mgon// lam zhugs rnams kyi ded dpon dang*// brgal 'dod rnams kyi gru dang ni// gzing dang zam pa nyid du gyur// gling don gnyer la gling dang ni// mar me 'dod la mar me dang*// gnas mal 'dod la gnas mal dang*// bdag ni lus can bran 'dod pa// kun gyi bran du 'gyur bar shog

/yid bzhin nor bu bum pa bzang*// rigs sngags grub dang sman chen dang*// dpag bsam gyi ni shing dag dang*// lus can rnams kyi 'dod 'jor gyur// sa sogs 'byung ba chen po dang*// nam mkha' bzhin du rtag bar yang*// sems can dpag tu med pa yi// rnam mang nyer 'tsho'i gzhir yang shog /de bzhin nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i// sems can khams la rnam kun du// thams cad mya ngan 'das bar du// bdag ni nyer 'tsho'i gzhir yang shog /ces pa'am/ yang na sho lo ka snga ma dang*/ sa sogs 'byung ba chen po dang*/ zhes pa man chod de la sho lo ka gsum brjod par bya'o// gnyis pa dam bca' ba ni/ chos thams cad don dam par spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral yang*// kun rdzob tu bdag gzhan bde sdug la sogs pa sna tshogs su snang zhing*/ snang ba de dag mdo ting 'dzin rgyal po las// sgyu ma byed pa dag gis gzugs sprul te// rta dang glang po shing rta sna tshogs byas/ de la ji bzhin snang ba gang yang med// chos rnams thams cad de 'drar shes par gyis/ zhes gsungs pas/ thams cad bden pa med pa yin yang*/ sems can rnams kyis de ltar mi shes par bden par bzung bas 'khor bar (301)sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa myong zhing*/ de ltar sdug bsngal ba'i sems can de thams cad thog ma med pa nas phan btags pa'i drin can yin pas/ de thams cad bdag gis sdug bsngal las bsgral dgos par 'dug /da ltar bdag la de dag sgrol ba'i nus pa med pas/ de thams cad sgrol ba la sangs rgyas thob dgos par 'dug pas/ bdag gi bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par bya ba'i phyir/ byang chub tu sems bskyed cing*/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ dge ba'i chos sdud pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ sems can gyi don byed pa'i tshul khrims te/ tshul khrims gsum po de la/ sngon gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis/

ji ltar bslab pa de bzhin du bslab par bya'o snyam du bsam zhing*/ dgongs su gsol brjod pa na/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bdag gi bsam sbyor rnams ji lta ba bzhin du mkhyen gyis yod pas/ mkhyen gyin yod des snyam du nges par byas nas/ sems rtse gcig pa'i sgo nas bla ma dkon mchog la dad pa dang*/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las bsgral bar 'dod pa'i snying rje dang*/ de'i ched du bdag gis sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa'i 'dun pa chen po dang ldan pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ rang gi ming nas smos te bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du// ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis// byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang*/ (302)byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la// de dag rim bzhin gnas ba ltar// de bzhin 'grol phan don du// byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing*// de bzhin du ni bslab pa la'ang*// rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi'o/ /zhes brjod/ ji ltar sngon gyis sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyis sems can thams cad kyi don du/ sangs rgyas thob par bya'o snyam pa smon pa'i sems bskyed nas/ 'jug pa byang sems kyi bslab pa/ tshul khrims gsum la rim pa bzhin du bslab pa ltar/ bdag gis kyang smon pa dang 'jug pa gnyis la de ltar bslab par bya'o snyam pa'i sems kyis rjes zlos gnyis pa brjod/ bla ma dkon mchog la dad pa chen po dang*/ sems can la brtse ba chen po dang*/ sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi 'dun pa chen po ste chen bo gsum dang ldan sgo nas/ sngon gyi sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyis smon 'jug gnyis kyi sems bskyed pa de bzhin du bdag gis kyang sems can thams cad kyi don du/

cis kyang sangs rgyas thob par bya zhing*/ sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa tshul khrims gsum po de la nges par bslab par bya'o// de'i dpang por bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang sems rnams bzhugs so snyam pa'i sgo nas rjes zlos gsum pa 'di shin tu gal che bas bshad pa rnams brda 'phrod pa dang*/ dam bca'i tshig rnams dal zhing dod pa skabs phyed pa brjod pa'i sgo nas rjes zlos gsum pa brjod/ gsum pa rjogs pa dang smon 'jug gi sems nges par skye ba yin bas skyes snyam pa'i thob shes kyi dga' ba bskyed par zhu/ zhes brjod par bya'o/ /gsum pa rjes kyi cho ga la gnyis/ dga' ba bsgom pa dang*/ gtong rag 'bul ba'o// dang po (303)rang dga' ba bsgom pa dang*/ gzhan dga' ba bsgom du gzhugs pa gnyis kyi/ dang po ni/ bdag gis thog ma med pa nas lus dpag tu med pa blangs kyang*/ don chen po ma grub bas da dung 'khor bar lus pa yin pa la/ da res rang gzhan thams cad kyi phan bde'i rgyur/ byang chub kyi sems rin po che rgyur la skyes pas/ don chen po grub snyam pa'i dga' ba bsgom par bya'o// de tsam du dga' ba bsgoms pa'i phan yon ci yod ce na/ phan yon shin tu mang ste/ ming don 'pho ba/ sdig pa stobs chen spong ba/ bsod nams rgya chen thob pa/ yon tan mtha' yas thob pa/ phan yon dpes bstan pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par 'gyur ba/ phan yon lung dang sbyar ba dang bdun gyi/ dang po ming don 'pho ba ni// byang chub sems dpa'i spyod 'jug las// byang chub sems bskyed gyur na skad cig gis// 'khor ba'i brtson rar bsdams pa'i nyam thag rnams// bde gshegs rnams kyi sras zhes brjod bya zhing*// 'jig rten lha mir bcas pa'i phyag byar 'gyur/ zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa sdig pa stobs chen spong ba ni/ sdig pa shin tu mi bzad byas na yang*// dpal la brten nas 'jigs pa chen po ltar// gang la brten nas yud kyis sgrol 'gyur pa// de la bag can rnams kyis cis mi brten// de ni dus mtha'i me bzhin sdig chen rnams// skad cig gis ni nges par sreg par byed//

ces gsungs so// gsum pa bsod nams rgya chen thob pa ni/ dpal byin gyis zhus ba'i mdo las// byang chub sems kyi bsod nams gang*// (304)gal te de la gzugs mchis na// nam mkha'i khams ni kun bkang te// de bas kyang ni lhag par 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// bzhi pa yon tan mtha' yas pa thob pa ni// blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las// rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems dang chos 'dzin dang*// chos sgrub pa dang srog chags snying brtse ba// chos bzhi 'di dag yon tan mtha' med de// 'di dag mtha' ni rgyal bas mi gsungs ngo*// zhes gsungs so// lda pa la phan yon dpes bstan pa la gsum las/ dman pa mchog tu bsgyur ba gser 'gyur rtsi'i dpes bstan pa ni/ spyod 'jug las/ gser 'gyur rtsi yi rnam pa mchog lta bur// mi gtsang lus 'di blangs nas rgyal ba'i sku// rin chen rin thang med par bsgyur bas nas/ byang chub sems zhes bya ba rab brtan zung*/ zhes gsungs/ rnyed dka' zhing rin che ba rin po che'i dpes bstan pa ni// 'gro ba'i ded dpon gcig pu tshad med blos// legs par yongs su brtags nas rin che bas// 'gro ba'i gnas dang bral bar 'dod pa rnams// rin chen byang chub sems legs brten par 'gyur/ zhes gsungs/ 'bras bu mi zad cing 'phel ba dpag bsam gyi shing gi dpes bstan pa ni// dge ba gzhan kun chu shing bzhin du ni// 'bras bu spyad nas zad par 'gyur ba nyid// byang chub sems kyi ljon shing rtag par yang*// 'bras bu 'byin pas mi zad 'phel bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// drug pa sangs rgyas la mchod par 'gyur ba ni// blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las/ gsum po 'di dag ni de bzhin gshegs (305)pa la mchod pa bla na med pa yin te/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang*/ dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa dang*/ srog chags rnams la snying brtse ba'o zhes dang*/ thabs la mkhas pa'i mdo las kyang*/

gang zhig sangs rgyas thams cad mchod 'dod pas// de yis brtan par byang chub sems bskyed bya/ zhes pas byin gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ gaṅga'i bye ma'i grangs snyed kyi// sangs rgyas zhing kun mi gang gis// rin chen bdun gyis yongs bkang ste// sangs rgyas rnams la phul ba bas// gang gis thal mo sbyar byas te// byang chub tu ni sems btud na// bsod nams 'di ni khyad par 'phags// zhes gsungs so/ bdun pa phan yon lung dang sbyar ba ni/ sangs rgyas phal po che las/ gzhon nu nor bzang gis 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi drung du byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la ji ltar slob pa'i tshul rgya cher shes par bya ba'i phyir bla ma lnga bcu rtsa gnyis bsten cing*/ lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram du mgon po byams pas 'khor mang po la chos bstan pa de'i drung du phyin te/ phyag 'tshal nas/ bdag gis byang chub kyi sems bskyed na/ de'i bslab pa rnams la ji ltar slob pa'i tshul rnams ma shes pas/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la slob pa'i tshul rnams rgya cher bstan du gsol zhes zhus pas/ byams pas rigs kyi bu khyod ni/ yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis zin te/ byang chub kyi sems ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi sa bon lta bu'o/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi chos dkar po rnam par 'phel bar byed pas zhing lta bu'o// nyes par byas pa thams cad (306)sreg pas bskal pa'i me lta bu'o// mi dge ba'i chos thams cad zad par byed pa'i phyir sa'i 'og lta bu'o// don thams cad yongs su sgrub pas yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal po lta bu'o// bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pas bum pa bzang po lta bu'o// 'khor ba'i chu la rgyu ba 'don pas lcags kyu lta bu'o// lha dang*/ mi dang*/ lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten na mchod rten lta bu ste/ mdor na sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad dang sangs rgyas kyi yon tan ji snyed yod pas/

byang chub kyi sems kyi yon tan dang phan yon yang de snyed do/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad 'di las byung ste/ 'das pa dang*/ ma 'ongs pa dang*/ da ltar byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyang 'di las skyes so// zhes gsungs so// de ltar yon tan dpag tu med pa dang ldan pa'i byang chub kyi sems skyes pa de la dga' spro dang ldan zhing*/ 'di ltar 'byung ba'i tshig 'di rnams don la yang legs par sems shing dga' spro bskyed pa'i ngang nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod// mi yi srid pa legs par thob// de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to// da ni bdag gis ci nas kyang*// rigs dang mthun pa'i las brtsams te// skyon med btsun pa'i rigs 'di la// rnyog par mi 'gyur de ltar bya// long bas phyag dar phung po las// ji ltar rin chen rnyed pa ltar// de bzhin ji zhig ltar stebs nas// bdag la byang chub sems 'di skyes// 'gro ba'i 'chi bdag 'joms byed pa'i// bdud rtsi'i mchog kyang 'di yin no// 'gro ba'i dbul ba sel ba yi// mi zad gter yang (307)'di yin no// 'gro ba'i nad rab zhi byed pa'i// sman gyi mchog kyang 'di yin no// srid lam 'khyams shing dub pa yi// 'gro ba ngal gso'i ljon shing yin// 'gro ba thams cad ngan 'gro las// sgrol bar byed pa'i spyi stegs yin// 'gro ba'i nyon mongs gdung sel ba'i// sems kyi zla ba shar ba yin// 'gro ba'i mi shes rab rib dag /dpyis 'byin nyi ma chen po yin// dam chos 'o ma bsrub pa la// mar gyi snying khu phyung ba yin// 'gro ba'i mgon po srid pa'i lam rgyu ba'i// bde ba'i longs spyod spyad par 'dod pa la// 'di ni bde ba'i mchog tu nyer gnas nas// sems can mgron chen tshim par byed pa yin/

/zhes brjod// yang na tshig bcad dang po gnyis tsam brjod pas chog go /gnyis pa gzhan dga' ba bsgom du gzhug pa ni/ bdag gis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spyan sngar byang chub tu sems bskyed nas/ sems can thams cad gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde ba la 'god pas/ thams cad dga' bar gyis shig snyam pa'i bsam pa dang ldan pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bdag gis de ring skyob pa thams cad kyi// spyan sngar 'gro ba bde gshegs nyid dang ni// bar du bde la mgron du bos zin gyis// lha dang lha min la sogs dga' bar gyis/ zhes brjod do/ gnyis pa gtang rag gi mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ de ltar byang chub kyi sems skyes pa de/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gi bka' drin yin pas/ de'i drin lan du mchod pa'i bye brag dang gtor ma 'bul ba yin pas dngos sam yid kyis rjes su zlos par 'tshal/ mchod pa rnams kha gsol/ spos dang mar me sogs gsar du 'du 'bul la/ byin rlabs dang sngar ltar tshig bcad dbyangs dang bcas te 'bul/ rgyal dang de sras rnams la (308)bdag gis sogs kyis lus 'bul ba dang*/ me tog dam pa

sogs bzang spyod las byung ba'i mchod pa sho lo ka gsum gyis dbul lo/ gtor ma rnams chu gtsang gis bran la/ oṃ a mri te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snong yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur bar bsam la oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar sngar bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgyar bcas te/ oṃ sarba gu ru buddha dharma saṃ ga te bhyaḥs pa ri wā ri oṃ a kā ro btags pa gsum mam lngas phul/ mtshan sngags de nyid sngon 'gro' ི ārghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ bla ma mchog dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum gyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi rgyud la byang chub kyi sems rin po che ma skyes pa bskyed pa dang*/ skyes pa gong nas gong du 'phel bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab bo// gtor ma gnyis pa 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang*/ sems can rnams bde zhing skyid pa dang*/ bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi byang chub kyi sems rin po che mi nyams shing gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i phrin las dang sdong grogs rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/ zhes pas phul// gtor ma gsum pa 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra ā karṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pas sbyan drangs la/ oṃ lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ri oṃ a ka (309)ro sogs kyis gyis mthar/ 'jig rten skyong ba chen po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams mchod sbyin gtor ma sogs nas/

byang chub kyi sems rin po che 'phel zhing rgyas pa la bar chad mi 'byung ba'i phrin las dang stong grogs rgya chen po mdzod cig ces dang*/ gtor ma bzhi pa 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra ā karṣa ya dzaḥ zhes bas bkug la/ sngar gyi mthar a kā ro btags pa lan gsum mi gyis bsngos la/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di gzhi bdag /gnas bdag /grong bdag dkor bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams la 'bul lo// mchod do// stob bo// bzhes shig /bstan pa dar ba dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams su bde legs thams cad 'byung ba dang*/ bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyis byang chub sems rin po che bskyed pa la dga' zhing rangs nas/ bar du gcod pa thams cad srung ba'i stong grogs dam pa mdzod cig /sngags kyi mthar gatstsha btags pas rang gnas su gshegs su gsol/ gnyis pa bar du mi nyams par bsrung ba'i tshul la gnyis/ bslab bya ngos bzung ba dang*/ de nyid bsrung tshul gyis 'gag bsdu ba'o// dang po la smon 'jug sbyi'i bslab bya dang*/ bye brag so so'i bslab bya'o// dang po spyi'i bslab bya la sgrub par bya ba'i chos gsum dang shes par bya ba'i chos bzhi las/ dang po ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bsten cing de la 'dun pa dang*/ dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung rgyun mi gcod pa dang*/ sems can blos mi 'dor ba'o// der ma zad byang chub tu sems bskyed nas de ma nyams par bsrung ba dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod klog pa dang*/ rgyun du bag yod bstan pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ ltung ba dang*/ ltung ba med pa dang*/ ltung ba'i (310)gzugs brnyan dang*/ ltung med kyi gzugs brnyan rnams legs par shes par bya'o// mdor na byang chub sems dpas sgrub pa'i bslab bya bsam gyis mi khyab kyang bsdu na gsum yin te/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par bya ba dang*/ sems can yongs su smin par bya ba dang*/

sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par bya ba'o// gnyis pa bye brag gi bslab bya la smon pa dang*/ 'jug pa'i bslab bya gnyis las/ dang po la skyes bu dam pa'i smon pa gsum dang*/ spang bya nag po'i chos bzhi dang*/ sgrub bya dkar po'i chos bzhi la bslab pa'o// dang po ni/ sems can gyi don du rdzogs byang thob par bya'o snyam pa 'bras bu la smon pa dang*/ sa dang lam thams cad la bslab par bya'o snyam pa thabs la smon pa dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi re ba bskang bar bya'o snyam pa'i phrin las la smon pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ bla ma dang sbyin gnas bslu ba dang*/ theg pa chen po'i gang zag la mi bsngags pa brjod pa dang*/ sems can la g.yo sgyu byed pa dang*/ 'gyod pa'i gnas ma yin pa la 'gyod pa bskyed pa ste nag po'i chos bzhi po de spong ba la nan tan du bya'o// gsum pa ni/ srog gi phyir yang shes bzhin du rdzun mi smra ba dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed cing de dag gi yon tan gyi bsngags pa brjod pa dang*/ g.yo sgyu spangs te lhag pa'i bsam pas gnas pa dang*/ gdul bar bya ba'i sems can thams cad theg pa chen po'i dge ba la 'god pa ste/ de ltar dkar po'i chos bzhi po de la bslabs pas ni nag po'i chos bzhi po de yang shugs la khegs pa yin no// gnyis pa 'jug pa'i bslab bya la/ spang bya dang sgrub bya gnyis/ dang po la rtsa ba'i ltung ba dang yan lag gi ltung ba'o// (311)dang po la/ byang sems rgyal po la 'byung nye ba lnga dang*/ blon po la 'byung nye ba lnga/ las dang po la 'byung nye ba brgyad/ thun mong du smon sems btang ba'o// ltung ba de dag 'byung ba'i rten ni byang sems kyi sdom ldan/ smyo ba dang sems 'khrugs pa dang*/ tshor bas gzir ba sogs ma yin pa zhig dgos te smyo ba sogs kyi rten la rtsa ltung gang yang mi 'byung zhing*/ 'di dag la kun slong nyon mongs mi dgos te/

bya bar 'os pa dang mi 'os pa 'jug ldog log pa las ltung bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// de la dang po rgyal po la 'byung bar nye ba lnga ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi dkor 'phrog pa'am rku ba dang*/ dam pa'i chos spong pa'am spong du 'jug pa/ dge slong rab tu byung ba la yo byad 'phrog pa sogs kyi sgo nas gnod pa byed pa dang*/ mtshams med kyi las lnga po dag las gang yang rung ba byas pa/ log ltas rang mi dge bcu la spyod cing gzhan yang de la 'god pa dang lnga yin te/ nam mkha'i snying po'i mdor gsungs pa'i don bslab btus las/ dkon mchog gsum gyi dkor 'phrog pa// phas pham pa yi ltung bar 'dod// dam pa'i chos ni spong byed pa// gnyis par rgyal bas gsungs pa yin// tshul khrims 'chal ba'i dge slong la'ang*// ngur smig 'phrog dang rdeg pa dang*// brtson rar gzhug par byed pa dang*// rab tu byung las 'babs pa dang*// srog 'bral byed pa gsum pa yin// mtshams med lnga po byed pa dang*// log par lta ba 'dzin pa dang*/ zhes gsungs shing*/ dge 'dun las 'phrog pa ni rtsa ltung dang por 'du bas gsum par dge slong zhes bkar te gsungs pa'o// blon po la 'byung nye ba'i ltung ba lnga ni/ snga ma bzhi thun mongs pa dang*/ (312)log lta 'dzin pa'i tsha ba la/ grong ngam/ grong khyer sogs 'joms par byed pa rnams sngar ltar gcig tu bgrang pas lnga yin te/ grong la sogs pa 'jig pa yang*/ rtsa ba'i ltung bar rgyal bas gsungs/ zhes so// las dang po pa las 'byung bar nye ba brgyad ni/ dang po rim gyis theg chen la blo ma sbyangs par stong pa nyid bstan pas skrag nas de'i byang sems nyams par byed pa dang*/ gnyis pa rdzogs byang sgrub pa'i bsam la sbyor zhugs pa las phyir ldog par byed pa dang*/ gsum pa nyan thos kyi rigs can so sor thar pa la slob pa dag la dgos pa khyad par can med par de spangs nas theg chen la sbyor ba dang*/

bzhi pa nyan thos kyi theg pas nyon mongs spong mi nus par rang nyid 'dzin cing gzhan yang 'dzin du bcug nas de'i bshad nyan 'gog pa dang*/ lnga pa rnyed bkur gyi phyir rnyed bkur can gzhan la phrag dog gis bdag la bstod cing gzhan la smod pa dang*/ drug pa stong nyid ma rtogs kyang rtogs so zhes mi chos bla ma'i rdzun du smras pa dang*/ bdun pa dge sbyong dang rgyal rigs phye nas dge sbyong la nor gyi chad pa gcod du 'jug pa dang 'bril ba'i ltung ba dang*/ brgyad pa chos ldan gyi dge sbyong la gnod pa'i khrims ngan bcas te zhi gnas kyis mtshon pa'i rnal 'byor 'dor bar byed pa dang*/ dge slong yang dag 'jog gi nor phrog nas kha ton pa la ster ba rnams te/ blo sbyangs ma byas sems can la// stong pa nyid ni brjod pa dang*// zhes pa nas/ de dag rtsa ba'i ltung ba ste// sems can dmyal ba chen po rgyu/ zhes pa'i bar sho lo ka lnga dang rkang pa gnyis kyis bstan pa rnams so// de ltar na rten gyi sgo nas bco brgyad du gsungs kyang rdzas kyi sgo nas bcu bzhir nges pa'o// thun mong du smon sems gtang (313)ba ni rang don du zhi bde don gnyer gyi blo skyes na ltung ba'i nang nas lci shos yin te/ sdud pa las/ gal te bskal pa du mar dge ba'i las lam bcu// spyod kyang rang rgyal dgra bcom dag la 'dod bskyed na// de tshe tshul khrims skyon 'byung tshul khrims 'chal ba ste// sems bskyed de ni phas pham bas kyang shin tu lci/ zhes gsungs pas bcu dgu dang*/ de'i steng du dkon brtsegs las/ 'jug sems spangs te dge la mi sbyor ba dang nyi shu yin no// zhes kyang 'byung ngo*// gnyis pa yan lag gi ltung ba ni/ rtsa bar ma gtogs pa'i lus dang ngag dang yid kyis bslab bya las nyams pa rnams te/ dang po ni/ mig phab ste blta bar bya ba sogs bsgrub bya dang don med rgyug mchang sogs dgag bya las nyams pa'o/

gnyis pa ni/ legs par 'ongs so zhes bya ba sogs bsgrub bya dang*/ bre mo'i gtam smra ba sogs dgag bya las nyams pa'o// gsum pa ni/ byams snying rje dang dran shes bag yod brten pa sogs bsgrub bya dang*/ chags sdang mi spong ba sogs dgag bya'i bslab bya las nyams pa ste dbang po 'bring brtul gyi yan lag gi nyes pa rnams kyang de dag tu 'du bar bshad do// de yang rtsa ltung rnams la kun slong nyon mongs drag zhan sogs kyi dbye ba med kyang rtsa ltung de dag byung nas thun tshod las 'das na 'jug pa sems bskyed kyi sdom pa ni gtong la/ smon pa sems bskyed kyi sdom pa ni ji srid rdzogs byang las blo ma log pa de srid du mi gtong ngo*// des na smon sems gtang ba rtsa ltung dang sdom pa'i gtong rgyu gnyis kar 'dod pa dbu ma pa'i lugs so// rtsa ltung byung yang thun tshod las ma 'das gang du 'gyod pa skyes na sdom pa mi gtong la/ thun tshod ni nyin zhag gcig gi drug cha'i mtha' 'o// nyes byas ni nyin zhag gcig 'das na (314)ltung bar 'gyur ro// gnyis pa sgrub pa'i bslab bya ni/ ji skad bshad pa'i ltung ba rnams spong ba'i sems pa sa bon dang bcas pa ni nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang*// pha rol tu phyin pa drug gis bsdus pa'i dge tshogs bsgrub pa la bslab pa ni dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims dang*/ sems can rnams kyi gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan bde bsgrub par 'dod pa'i sems sa bon dang bcas pa ni sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims te tshul khrims gsum po de la nan tan du bslab par bya ste/ yum bar ma las/ gang kha na ma thob sdom pa'i sems dang*/ dge ba'i chos sdud pa'i sems dang*/ sems can smin par byed pa'i sems te/ sems bskyed pa 'di gsum la nan tan du bya'o// zhes dang*/ byang sa las/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims thams cad ni gsum po 'di dag tsam kho nar zad de/

zhes byang sems kyi bslab bya thams cad de gsum du 'dus pas de'i spang bya rnams spong zhing*/ bsgrub bya rnams la rtse gcig tu bslab par bya'o// gnyis pa de nyid bsrung ba la/ nyes dmigs bsam pa dang*/ bsrung tshul dngos so// dang po la khas blangs nyams pa/ ming don shor ba/ ngan song du ltung ba'o// dang po ni/ ston pa sangs rgyas bslus pas sangs rgyas mi mnyes/ yul sems can bslus pas sems can mi mgu/ rang ched du bslus pas rang don nyams shing lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis smad pa ste/ blo gros rgya mtsho'i mdor/ byang chub sems dpa' de ltar sems bskyed nas ji skad smras pa bzhin mi byed na lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten bslus pa yin no// zhes sogs gsungs pa dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ rgyal po rgyal srid shor ba ltar tshe 'dir bkra mi shis pa sna tshogs (315)'byung zhing*/ 'chi khar mya ngan gyis gdung bar mdo las gsungs so// gsum pa ni/ phyi mar ngan song du 'gro zhing de las kyang thar bar dka' ba dang*/ rtsa ltung gi nyes pas ni sngon du bskyed pa'i byang sems kyi dge rtsa thams cad 'jig pa dang*/ dkon mchog lha dang bcas pa bslus pas spyir ngan 'gro dang*/ khyad par dmyal bar skye bar gsungs te/ sems can dmyal ba chen po'i rgyu/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// gnyis pa ni/ de lta bu'i nyes dmigs can gyi ltung ba de 'byung ba'i rgyu ni/ mi shes pa dang*/ bag med pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa mang ba dang*/ ma gus pa'o// de la mi shes pa ni bslab pa la 'bad kyang ltung ba'i mtshan nyid mi shes pas ltung ba 'byung ba ste// de'i gnyen por bslab bya rnams nyan nas shes par bya'o// bag med pa ni ltung ba shes kyang nyes dmigs ma mthong ba'am/ mthong yang dran shes med pas ltung ba 'byung ba ste/ de'i gnyen por blang dor gyi dmigs rnams mi brjed pa'i dran pa dang sgo gsum la so sor rtog cing legs nyes gang la 'jug ldog shes par byed pa'i shes bzhin dang*/

bdag gam chos kyi dbang du byas nas nyes pa la 'dzem pa'i ngo tsha shes pa dang*/ gzhan gyis smad du 'ong snyam nas 'dzem pa'i khrel yod dang nyes spyod kyi rnam smin la 'jigs nas bag yod la bslab par bya'o// nyon mongs pa mang ba ni/ 'dzem bag cung zad skyes kyang dug gsum shas che bas nyon mongs pa las ltung ba 'byung ba ste/ de'i gnyen por rang rgyud la brtags te nyon mongs gang shas che ba la gnyen po 'bad nas bsten cing 'di tsam 'gal yang nyes pa chung ngo snyam pa'i bag yangs kyi tshod yod mi bya'o// ma gus pa ni/ ltung ba sogs shes kyang dman (316)pa la mos nas bslab pa la mi 'jug pas ltung ba 'byung ba ste/ de'i gnyen por ston pa dang*/ de'i bcas pa rnams la gus par bya'o// de yang mi shes pa dang bag med pas ltung ba chung ngu*/ nyon mongs mang ba la 'bring*/ ma gus pa la chen po 'byung zhing bsam pa'i khyad par gyis ci rigs par 'gyur ba'ang yod do// des na blang dor gyi gnas rnams la srog brdos byas nas bslab pa la nan tan du bya ste/ ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ khyim pa skya bo'i gos gyon la/ ngas ni bslab pa gang bshad pa// de tshe dge slong de dag la// bslab pa de yang med par 'gyur// zhes dge bsnyen la gsungs pa'i bslab gzhi lnga po dge slong gis kyang bsrung ba med pa'i dus 'dir bslab pa la brtson pa ni 'bras bu lhag par yang che ba ste/ de nyid las/ gang gis dam chos rab tu 'jig pa dang*// bde gshegs bstan pa 'gag par gyur pa'i tshe// nyin mtshan du ni bslab pa gcig spyod pa// bsod nams 'di ni de bas khyad par 'phags// zhes gsungs so// gsum pa nyams pa phyir 'chos pa la/ nyes pa gshags pa'i tshul dang*/ sdom pa btang na slar blang pa'i tshul lo// dang po la theg chen spyi ba'i lugs dang*/ dbu ma rang lugs kyi bshags pa'o// dang po ni/ bshags bya'i yul ltung bas ma gos pa'i byang sems sam/

rten gyi drung du sngar byas kyi nyes pa la 'gyod sems dang*/ phyin chad mi bya ba'i sdom sems dang ldan pa'i sgo nas btud de/ dgongs gsol byas nas/ bdag byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la nyes pa 'di lta bu zhig byung ste/ bdag byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i nyes (317)pa de phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan sngar mthol zhing bshags so/ 'thol zhing bshags na bdag bde ba la gnas par 'gyur gyi/ ma 'thol ma bshags na ni de ltar mi 'gyur ro// zhes lan gsum dang thabs legs bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ ngan song du ltung bas 'jigs te 'gyod pa chen pos 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po mthong bar nus na de la dngos su bshags pa dang*/ de ltar mi nus na tho rangs langs la gtsang sbra dang ldan pas shar du phyogs te mchod cing lha'i bu skya rings la 'phrin gsol nas/ rmi lam du de'i mdun du ltung ba bshags pa dang*/ phyag bya ba dang*/ gzungs sdugs bzla ba sogs kyi sgo nas 'phags pa de mngon sum du mthong ba'am/ sdig pa dag pa'i rtags ma byung gi bar du bshags pa bya ste/ bslab btus su/ rmi lam 'phags pa nam snying po'i// mdun du 'dug ste bshags par bya// zhes dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du// phung po gsum pa 'don bya zhing*// rgyal dang byang chub sems brten nas// ltung ba'i lhag ma des zhi bya// zhes dang*/ chos bzhi bstan pa'i mdo las kyang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdig pa thams cad stobs bzhis 'dag par gsungs pas sku gzugs la sogs pa'i spyan sngar ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa dang bcas pas sam/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang byang chub kyi sems yongs su mi gtong ba ni rten gyi stobs dang*/ sngar byas kyi nyes pa la dug 'thungs pa lta bu'i 'gyod pa drag po skyes pa ni rnam par sun 'byin pa'i stobs dang*/

ltung ba'i gnyen por sku gzugs bzhengs (318)pa dang phyag mchod bskor ba bzlas brjod dang ting nge 'dzin dang stong nyid sgom pa sogs dge ba la brtson pa ni gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs dang*/ phyin chad srog la babs kyang sdig pa'i las 'di dag mi bya'o snyam du dam bca' brtan par byed pa las ldog pa'i stobs ste bzhi yin no// gnyis pa sdom pa btang na blang ba'i tshul ni/ rtsa ltung byung na thun tshod las 'das na sdom pa gtong bas len dgos la/ len yul dge ba'i bshes gnyen ma rnyed na rten gyi drung du sngar bzhin blangs pas skye ba yin no// mdor na dbu ma lugs kyi bslab bya ni/ rang gis lus longs spyod dge tshogs dang bcas pa sems can kun la btang ba dang*/ de dag mi nyams par bsrung ba dang*/ dri ma dag par bya ba dgongs nas gong du spel ba bya ba rnams bya ba yin te/ bslab btus las/ gang gis ltung bar mi 'gyur ba'i// gnad kyi gnad rnams 'dir rigs bya// gnad kyi gnad de gang zhe na// bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang*// dge ba dus gsum skyes pa rnams// sems can rnams la gtong ba dang*// de bsrung dag pa spel ba'o// zhes dang*/ de thams cad kyi rtsa ba yang sems bsrung ba la thug ste/ spyod 'jug las/ bslab pa bsrung bar 'dod pa yis// rab tu bsgrim nas sems bsrungs te// zhes gsungs shing*/ sems bsrung ba'i thabs kyang de nyid las// sems bsrung 'dod pa rnams la ni// dran pa dang ni shes bzhin dag /srogs la bab kyang srungs shig ces// de ltar bdag ni thal mo sbyor// zhes dang*/ rnga sgra'i tshig bcad las kyang*/ bdag ni nor ni gtang la lus bsrung ngo*// nor dang lus kyang gtang la srog (319)bsrung ngo*// nor dang lus dang de bzhin srog rnams kyang*// thams cad gtong la 'dir ni chos bsrung ngo*// zhes gsungs pa ltar bslab pa la 'bad par bya'o// gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/

de rnams kyi sgo na dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam chen/ bla na med pa'i byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i cho ga dbu ma lugs zhes yongs su grags pa'i bka' srol chen po de nyid legs par phul grub pa yin pas/ ji skad bshad pa'i bslab bya rnams mi nyams par bsrung ba'i sgo nas sems can gyi don ci nus bgyi snyam pas 'di'i ces zlos lan gsum gyis/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa

sogs dang*/ maṇḍal dang*/ deng nas sogs brjod la/ de ltar na rang re rnams kyis theg pa chen po'i lam thams cad kyi rtsa ba byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i sdom pa yang dag par 'bogs pa dang blangs pa dag las byung ba'i bsod nams kyi phung po dpag tu med pa gcig yod pa de dag bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi phyir yongs su bsngo dgos pas bsngo ba dang smon lam gyi mthun 'gyur thugs la 'dogs par zhu/ zhes mtshams sbyar la/ rgyas par na mthun 'gyur bcas pa'i bsngo ba dang*/ bzang spyod byams smon sogs theg pa chen po'i smon lam/ bkra shis bcas rgyas par brjod/ bsdu ba na/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa sogs dang*/ byang chub sems ni rin po che/ sogs ji ltar 'os pa dang shis brjod bya'o// 'dir rgyal sras thogs med gsungs la/ sems bskyed gcig las gcig gis thob pa'i brgyud pa la slob dpon zhi ba lha med kyang*/ dgra las rnam rgyal kyis sems bskyed kyis cho ga spyod 'jug gi lugs su mdzad cing*/ de man chad de'i rjes su 'brangs pa yin pas/ tshig mi 'dra ba'i (320)rigs pa byung yang*/ don spyod 'jug gi lugs yin te/ bla ma gong ma'i rnam bzhag las kyang*/ slob dpon chen po zhi ba lha'i lugs zhes gsungs so// yang dgra las rnam rgyal gyis spyod 'jug gi gzhung phral nas smon 'jug sdom pa rim gyis len par mdzad kyang*/ slob dpon nag po zhabs kyis dka' 'grel nas/ smon 'jug so sor len na gzhung phral nas len la/ stabs su len na gzhung ji lta ba bzhin len par gsungs pas/ 'di ni gzhung ji lta ba bzhin skabs su len pa'i cho ga yin no// zhes gsungs/ de ltar dbu ma lugs kyi 'di la'ang phyag len rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum snang ba'i rgyas pa ni 'dir bkod pa nyid mthar chags su btang ba yin cing*/ nyams len phyir bcos pa'i tshul ma brjod kyang chog /'bring po byed na/

'o skol rnams rnyed par dka' ba zhes pa nas/ sems bskyed kyi cho ga sgrub sdong po bkod pa sogs nas/ dbu ma lugs kyi cho ga bsgrub par bgyi ba yin/ de la thog mar yul khyad par can la gsol ba gdab pa sogs sbrel la/ sbyor ba gsol gdab/ skyabs 'gro// yan lag bdun pa bzang spyod ltar byas pas chog /dngos gzhi sngar dang 'dra/ rjes gzhan dga' ba bskyed pa'i bar byas nas bsngo ba bya'o// bsdus pa ni/ yan lag bdun pa byas nas/ byang chub snying po mchis kyi bar/ sogs dang*/ ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis/ sogs sngar ltar brjod pa'i rjes su rang gzhan dga' ba bskyed pa sngar ltar byas pas kyang 'grub la/ de dag gang gi tshe'ang mthar bsngo smon tshul bzhin bya'o// rgyu rkyen rnam dag sems kyi sa bon ni// legs par thebs nas 'phel zhing rab rgyas pa'i// byang chub chen po'i spyod pa rgyal ba'i sras// dus gsum gshegs pa kun las ches 'phags shog /mkha' khyab 'gro kun rgyud la rin chen sems/ dka' ba med par gcig car sad nas kyang*// bzang po spyod pa brgya mtsho'i mthar phyin te// kun bzang rnam thar bsam yas 'grub gyur cig /slob dpon chen po zhi ba lha'i bka' srol gyi rjes su 'brang ba'i sems bskyed cho ga (321)rgyal ba'i sras po thogs med bzang po dpal gyis mdzad pa las go bde ba'i sa bcad dang bslab bya'i tshul sogs dam pa gong ma gzhan dag gi legs bshad tshad ma dang sbyar te/ blo dman la phan pa'i bsam pas rang bzos ma bslad par rgyal ba'i sras po'i ming tsam 'dzin pa blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sdes khams kyi zab bu lung rdzong shod bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sgrub gnas chen por bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/// /(322)
